title: 7 第7章 任务8 第8章 养剑师
content_zh:
见到林轩要走，俊美少年突然制止道：“且慢！
“怎么，段师弟还有事？”
主事青年问道。
“刘师兄，等一下，我和这位林师弟还有一些话要说。”
俊美少年道。
他也不管青年的反应，直接对着林轩说道：“一部黄阶高级剑法换你的这一招，同时，你加入战组后，我保证没人敢动你！”
“抱歉，没有兴趣。”
林轩淡淡的说道，这一招是他父亲传给他的，无论如何他都不会外传的。
青年耸耸肩，然后带着新人们离开了，只剩下俊美少年和唐玉还呆在原地。
“唐玉，你和那小子很熟吗？”
“不熟！”
唐玉有些生气，“段飞，警告你，不许打他的注意！”
“放心吧，一招剑法我还看不上眼。”
段飞嘴角泛起一丝微笑，目光中却是带着一丝冷意。
……
主事青年带着林轩等人先领取了身份牌，做了身份登记，然后交代了一些事情，就让众人自由活动。
这些新弟子大部分都是世家弟子，有不少兄弟姐妹都在这玄天宗，解散后，这些人都去寻找各自的小势力去了。
林轩在这玄天宗内只认识唐玉，原本唐玉让他加入战组，不过今天看那俊美少年的态度，他也不想加入战组了。
拿着手中的基本手册，林轩向任务堂走去。
在这玄天宗内，所有的资源都是要用贡献点和灵石来兑换的，比如说一本黄阶低级剑法，需要100贡献点加三十灵石才能兑换。

而这贡献点的获取，则是通过完成宗内发布的任务来获取的。
有些任务简单，但是贡献点少，那些贡献点多的，大多是凶险异常的，可以说是危险与机遇并存。
林轩的实力在凝脉境三阶，据他所知，这外门中凝脉境三阶算是中等水平，而凝脉境四五阶的则算是上等水平了，要想参加三个月后的内门测试，必须先达到凝脉五阶，这样才有足够的保证。
“嗯，三个月提高两阶修为，我需要丹药、功法、武器、灵石……”
林轩想着想着就感到头大了。
“只能努力的争取贡献点了。”
林轩打定注意，开始浏览那挂在墙上的任务。
这些任务分为九个等级，从一级到九级，难度越来越大，危险也越来越高。
当然，贡献点也是越来越多。
一般外门弟子只做前四级，林轩初来乍到，也想做个简单的任务来熟悉一下，他看到一个寻找紫夜草的任务，一株紫叶草10点贡献，算是比较高的了。
还未等他接取，就见一群人浩浩荡荡的闯了进来，这些人袖口都绘着一轮弯月，神情十分的嚣张。
带头的是一个黑脸少年，脸色有一道刀疤，有些狰狞恐怖。
他走到任务墙前，大手一挥，将一些低等级、高贡献的任务全部摘了下来，其中就包括林轩看中的那个紫叶草任务。
林轩心中恼怒，但却没有动手，一个任务而已，还不值得他出手。
不过，让他以外的是，他从那些人中发现了张彬。
张彬也看到了林轩，他微微一愣，惊讶道：“你竟然通过测试了，真是走狗屎运了！”
看到张彬的表情，在联想之前的红斑竹林卫，林轩很快就猜到那一定是张彬暗中动的手脚。
“以张彬的实力不可能有那么大的能耐，看来他背后一定有人。”
林轩心中猜测道。
“阿彬，怎么回事？”

那个脸上有疤的少年问道。
content_en:
Seeing Lin Xuan about to leave, the handsome young man suddenly stopped him and said: "Wait a minute!
"What, Junior Brother Duan, is there anything else? "
The young man in charge asked.
"Senior Brother Liu, wait a minute, this Junior Brother Lin and I still have something to say. "
The handsome young man said.
He didn't care about the young man's reaction and said directly to Lin Xuan: "A yellow-level high-level swordsmanship will replace your move. At the same time, after you join the battle group, I guarantee that no one will dare to touch you! "
"Sorry, not interested. "
Lin Xuan said lightly that this trick was passed down to him by his father, and he would never pass it on to anyone else.
The young man shrugged and left with the newcomers, leaving only the handsome young man and Tang Yu staying where they were.
"Tang Yu, are you familiar with that kid? "
"Not familiar! "
Tang Yu was a little angry, "Duan Fei, I'm warning you, don't hit his attention! "
"Don't worry, I can't stand a swordsmanship. "
A smile appeared at the corner of Duan Fei's mouth, but there was a hint of coldness in his eyes.
…
The young man in charge took Lin Xuan and others to receive ID badges and register their identities, then explained some things and allowed everyone to move around freely.
Most of these new disciples are disciples of aristocratic families, and many brothers and sisters are in Xuantian Sect. After the disbandment, these people all went to find their own small forces.
Lin Xuan only knew Tang Yu in Xuantian Sect. Tang Yu originally asked him to join the battle group, but looking at the attitude of the handsome young man today, he did not want to join the battle group.
Holding the basic manual in his hand, Lin Xuan walked towards the mission hall.
In Xuantian Sect, all resources must be exchanged for contribution points and spirit stones. For example, a yellow-level low-level swordsmanship requires 100 contribution points and thirty spirit stones to redeem it.
The contribution points are obtained by completing tasks issued by the sect.
Some tasks are simple, but contribute little, while those that contribute a lot are mostly dangerous and unusual. It can be said that dangers and opportunities coexist.
Lin Xuan's strength is at the third level of the Pulse Condensation Realm. As far as he knows, the third level of the Pulse Condensation Realm in the outer sect is considered to be at a medium level, while the fourth and fifth levels of the Pulse Condensation Realm are considered to be at the upper level. If you want to participate in the inner sect test three months later, you must first reach the fifth level of the Pulse Condensation Realm, so that there is enough guarantee.
"Well, to improve my cultivation by two levels in three months, I need pills, techniques, weapons, spiritual stones..."
Lin Xuan felt dizzy as he thought about it.
“We can only work hard to gain contribution points. "
Lin Xuan paid attention and began to browse the tasks hanging on the wall.
These tasks are divided into nine levels, from level one to level nine, with increasing difficulty and danger.
Of course, there are more and more contribution points.
Generally, outer disciples only do the first four levels. Lin Xuan was new here and wanted to do a simple task to get familiar with it. He saw a task of finding Purple Night Grass. One Purple Leaf Grass contributed 10 points, which was relatively high.
Before he could pick it up, he saw a group of people rushing in. These people had a crescent moon painted on their sleeves and looked very arrogant.
The leader was a black-faced boy with a scar on his face, which looked a bit ferocious and terrifying.
He walked to the task wall, waved his hand, and picked down all the low-level, high-contribution tasks, including the Purple Leaf Grass task that Lin Xuan was interested in.
Lin Xuan was angry, but he didn't take action. It was just a mission, and it was not worthy of his action.
However, what surprised him was that he discovered Zhang Bin among those people.
Zhang Bin also saw Lin Xuan, he was slightly stunned and said in surprise: "You passed the test, you are really lucky! "
Seeing Zhang Bin's expression, and thinking of the red-spotted bamboo forest guard before, Lin Xuan quickly guessed that Zhang Bin must have done something secretly.
"With Zhang Bin's strength, it is impossible for him to be that capable. It seems that there must be someone behind him. "
Lin Xuan guessed in his mind.
"Abin, what's going on? "
The boy with the scar on his face asked.
